name: Pre-signing release artifact tampering (effect-bearing)
description: Worked example of an effective package_release mutant on the git target. Models unauthorized modification of a release binary during package assembly before digital signing, causing the distributed artifact to contain attacker-controlled code while retaining a valid signature from the legitimate publisher. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective'.

placeholders.RELEASE_ARTIFACT: relative path to the release artifact selected for modification

attacker_values.TAMPERED_CONTENT: attacker-controlled binary payload or artifact content

preconditions: project has a release packaging process that assembles distributable artifacts
the attacker can modify an artifact before the digital signing stage
the packaging pipeline includes the modified artifact in the final release
